decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - Under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order 2015 (as amended), prior approval would be required and REFUSED for the following reason:

The local planning authority conclude that the developer has not provided accurate dimensions clearly indicating how far the enlarged part of the dwellinghouse extends beyond the rear of the dwellinghouse, as such the proposal does not accord with criterion  A.4(2) (a) (i) of Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended).
Reason : 2 - UUnder Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended), prior approval would be required and REFUSED for the following reason: 

The local planning authority conclude that the developer has not provided accurate dimensions clearly indicating the maximum height of the enlarged part of the dwellinghouse, therefore the proposal would not accord with criterion  A.4(2) (a) (ii) of Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended).
Reason : 3 - Under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order 2015 (as amended), prior approval would be required and REFUSED for the following reason:

The local planning authority conclude that the developer has not provided accurate dimensions clearly indicating the correct height of the eaves of the enlarged part of the dwellinghouse, as such the proposal does not accord with criterion  A.4(2) (a) (iii) of Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended).
Reason : 4 - Under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order 2015 (as amended), prior approval would be required and REFUSED for the following reason:

The proposed single storey rear extension is refused in accordance with Town and Country Planning (GPDO) 2015 (as amended) Class A, A.4(7) as the impact of the proposed development on the amenity of adjoining neighbours is considered to be materially harmful and unacceptable. The proposed single storey rear extension by reason of its combined height and depth results in an overbearing, dominant and visually intrusive form of development that would create a sense of enclosure and potentially results in overshadowing to the detriment of the residential amenity of nearby occupants, in particular no.33 Dahlia Gardens. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to, in particular, policies D12.1, D12.3 and D12.4 of Merton Local Plan (2024).
Reason : 5 - Under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order 2015 (as amended), prior approval would be required and REFUSED for the following reason:

The proposed materials would not be of similar appearance to existing and would fail to comply with condition A.3 (a) of Class A Part 1, Schedule 2, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
description: APPLICATION FOR PRIOR APPROVAL IN RESPECT OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION WITH A DEPTH OF 6M, MAXIMUM HEIGHT OF 3M AND EAVES HEIGHT OF 3M.
